english.note: Choose this when you want to explicitly present a claim as an allegation rather than an established fact.
Use this as the all-purpose, formal-leaning verb for declaring or asserting a belief, opinion, or fact.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for stating something as true without proving it.
This is the all-purpose choice for neutrally reporting that someone states a claim or position.
Use this in more formal contexts when someone asserts or claims that a statement is true.

examples.english: They allege that they were at home throughout the night of the incident, but they cannot provide any evidence.
examples.traditional: 被告聲稱案發當晚一直留喺屋企，但未能提出任何證據。
